evals.prompt: Materialize the attached repository fixture in a temporary directory. Analyze that monorepo and generate the complete project knowledge set for coding agents. It contains deployable services with distinct domain language. Preserve useful documentation already present.
evals.expected_output: Creates an evidence-backed root AGENTS.md, CONTEXT-MAP.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and CODE-MAP.md plus context-local glossaries where bounded contexts are real.
expectations: The output discovers packages from workspace configuration rather than documenting only the root manifest
CONTEXT-MAP.md links every generated context-local CONTEXT.md
ARCHITECTURE.md describes runtime structure while CODE-MAP.md maps concrete source and test paths
All local Markdown links resolve

evals.prompt: Materialize the attached repository fixture in a temporary directory. Create agent-facing project knowledge for this small single-service repository. The domain uses one coherent vocabulary and there are no existing knowledge documents.
evals.expected_output: Creates a concise single-context knowledge set without an unnecessary CONTEXT-MAP.md.
expectations: A root CONTEXT.md is created
CONTEXT-MAP.md is not created
AGENTS.md contains repository-specific commands and completion checks
CODE-MAP.md points to real entry points and focused tests

evals.prompt: Materialize the attached repository fixture in a temporary directory. Its payment handlers and focused tests moved, and it gained a worker entry point. Refresh the existing project knowledge without rewriting unaffected hand-authored sections.
evals.expected_output: Performs a focused refresh based on structural changes and preserves unaffected supported content.
expectations: Dead CODE-MAP.md paths are removed
The new worker entry point and renamed tests are linked
Unchanged knowledge documents are not rewritten
Existing human annotations supported by current code are preserved

evals.prompt: Materialize the attached repository fixture in a temporary directory. Generate AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and CODE-MAP.md there. The fixture represents an empty repository with no source, manifests, entry points, tests, or maintained documentation.
evals.expected_output: Stops and reports insufficient evidence without fabricating project knowledge.
expectations: No project knowledge files are created
The result explicitly reports insufficient repository evidence

evals.prompt: Materialize the attached repository fixture in a temporary directory. Refresh all agent knowledge after its package split. Existing ARCHITECTURE.md contains a human-authored ownership statement that conflicts with current package boundaries and cannot be resolved from repository evidence.
evals.expected_output: Updates evidenced structural facts while surfacing the unresolved ownership contradiction instead of guessing or silently deleting it.
expectations: The conflicting ownership claim is reported as a specific unknown
The human-authored statement is not silently replaced
All non-conflicting stale paths and boundaries are updated

evals.prompt: Materialize the attached repository fixture in a temporary directory. Update only CODE-MAP.md for the moved payment handler, renamed focused test, and new worker entry point. Leave all unaffected knowledge documents byte-for-byte unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Refreshes CODE-MAP.md only and validates its paths without rewriting the rest of the knowledge set.
expectations: Only CODE-MAP.md changes; AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, and ARCHITECTURE.md remain byte-for-byte identical to the fixture inputs
Every stale CODE-MAP.md path is removed
The moved handler, renamed focused test, and worker entry point are linked
Every CODE-MAP.md relative link resolves
